description: An event-driven agent descriptor. An agent is a bounded executor, not a capability holder: it consumes one topic family, produces results and never grants authority, writes a vault page or widens a scope.

descriptor.model_scope: The local model or engine the agent may call. It names a model, never a capability, key or signer socket.
descriptor.max_runtime_seconds: 1..3600; a timed-out agent publishes a failure event and stops.
descriptor.max_concurrency: 1..16; the bus refuses more than the declared number of in-flight tasks for one agent.

topics.syntax: A topic, a single-segment wildcard `*`, or a tail wildcard `>`; the same syntax as event-schema.json.
topics.rule: An agent subscribes only to its own role family and publishes only to its own result/event family.

rules: An agent is data-driven work, never authority. It cannot grant, revoke or widen a capability.
An agent never writes a vault page directly; a result is data until a human or a signed pipeline accepts it.
An agent must reject an event whose classification, department or scope exceeds its own context.
The cyber agent is defensive-only by default; offensive security is routed to the red role and is out of scope for the default fabric.
A result carries provenance and a refusal carries a reason; silence is not a result.
An agent cannot read the ledger, registry, keys or signer socket.
